title: Equivalence of three local forms of local equidimensionality for the relative dimension function
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the equivalence of three formulations of local equidimensionality for the relative dimension function, and shows that normal or Cohen-Macaulay schemes satisfy them (statement lines 8276-8297, tag 02RE-adjacent). The converse direction requires the observation that the set of points with a fixed value is open, and the two sufficient conditions come from the decomposition of a normal scheme into integral pieces and from the comparison of the relative dimension function with the dimension function given by local ring dimensions whose difference is locally constant. The openness argument is the substance, so the claim is H2.
